text: Election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for the appointed Term of Office ending October 26, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel to its January 23, 2024 meeting. 2. Appointed Lawrence Lo as Acting Chair for its December 12, 2023 meeting.
